snippet.title: Chromatic Fantasy trailer
snippet.description:
Chromatic Fantasy is a turn based puzzle game in which interactions between characters and obstacles depend on their color. 
Game is currently in development for Windows and is planned to release august 2021.
Wishlist on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1635650/Chromatic_Fantasy
Also try the demo.
